newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cotton exports reach 65,379 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cotton exports reach 65,379 tonnes.

text.p: Egypt exported 65,379 tonnes of cotton in the first 13 weeks of this season, the Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association (Alcotexa) said on Monday.
The U.S. had been the biggest buyer by far, at 19,844 tonnes, followed by Italy (13,509) and Switzerland (4,551).
The best selling grades were Giza 75 (25,940 tonnes) in the long staple group and Giza 70 (14,353 tonnes) in the extra long staple category, Alcotexa said.
Egypt had exported 49,953 tonnes by December 1, the end of the 11th week of the season, it added. The organisation coordinates prices and exports by private and state-owned firms.
Egypt has said it expects to export between 125,000 and 150,000 tonnes of this year's harvest.
Egypt exported only 19,050 tonnes of the 1995 cotton harvest because the crop was small and the government decided that most of it should go to the domestic textile industry.
